theme: Reproducible Large-Model Solving and Numerical Trust
decision: Gate Level-Up is accepted as the official consolidation scope; WP13 and WP14 are evidence-complete, WP15 is PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS on controlled subscale evidence, WP16 is FAIL on the frozen equilibrium criterion, WP17 is PARTIAL after PETSc remediation, and WP18-WP22 remain planned.

progress_accounting.accounting_note: The historical block, acquired status and active progress are governance views and are not additive. WP13-WP22 weights sum to the 55 percent extension; WP13 and WP14 are PASS, WP15 is PASS_WITH_LIMITATIONS, WP16 is FAIL, WP17 is PARTIAL and WP18-WP22 remain planned.

work_packages.title: Release truth and golden numerical baseline
pass_criteria: qualification, release and development SHA roles are distinct
golden numerical baseline is reproducible and digest-backed
no historical evidence is relabeled as current

work_packages.title: Large-scale execution contract
pass_criteria: model topology and true DOF are explicit
CPU/RAM/time/backend/preconditioner and digest capture is deterministic
resource-limited outcomes are not claims
stop_conditions: synthetic size claim without a real FEM solve

work_packages.title: Matrix-free TET4 V2, SPD and preconditioning
pass_criteria: public TET4 matrix-free route is numerically equivalent to assembled subscale reference
SPD assumptions and failure conditions are demonstrated
preconditioner behavior and deterministic replay are recorded
stop_conditions: matrix-free route silently changes the assembled result
work_packages.owner_decision: subscale equivalence and SPD evidence pass; workspace reuse kept for allocation reduction; no WP16 or 1M claim

work_packages.title: True 1M DOF qualification
pass_criteria: at least 1000000 real FEM DOF
public TET4 route with loads, BC and reactions
complete iterative solve without timeout or resource-limited verdict
valid residual, finite displacement, equilibrium and energy
matrix-free and assembled subscale comparison
two deterministic replays
CPU/RAM/threads/backend/preconditioner/versions and digests archived
stop_conditions: claim based only on assembly or preflight
work_packages.owner_decision: FAIL: frozen equilibrium criterion exceeded; no tolerance or solver change permitted

work_packages.title: PETSc/MPI and large sparse path
pass_criteria: PETSc/MPI path is reproducibly provisioned or explicitly unavailable
backend selection and solver/preconditioner configuration are explicit
serial fallback remains fail-closed and traceable
stop_conditions: environment-specific success presented as universal support
work_packages.owner_decision: PARTIAL: the historical 1e-8 PETSc route remains failing, while an explicit predeclared 1e-10 internal CG/GAMG route passes two real 1,029,000-DOF replays and a same-rtol subscale comparison under unchanged 1e-8 acceptance metrics; authorize a separate official WP16 retry review, without changing WP14 policy or public defaults

work_packages.title: 3M DOF ladder Bronze/Silver/Gold
pass_criteria: Bronze builds a real 3M FEM model and records resource/preflight envelope
Silver completes a reproducible full solve
Gold demonstrates PETSc/MPI distributed solve, restart and a second case or scaling point
work_packages.claims_policy: Bronze alone authorizes no 3M solve claim; Silver is the principal target; Gold is stretch.

work_packages.title: Adversarial robustness and HEX8 diagnostic
pass_criteria: BC, singularity, mesh, orientation and failure paths are fail-closed
HEX8 behavior is diagnosed against compatible references
no formulation promotion or threshold weakening is inferred
stop_conditions: low-order limitation treated as an unexplained solver defect

work_packages.title: Residual J2 and external V&V closure
pass_criteria: increment, tangent and residual gaps are characterized on the existing bounded J2 scope
comparable external evidence is reproducible
finite-kinematic J2 remains outside qualification

work_packages.title: Architecture, API and registry surgical cleanup
pass_criteria: interfaces and dependency direction are documented
registry/API cleanup is incremental
legacy routes and public imports remain compatible

work_packages.title: Final release qualification
pass_criteria: final regression and package checks pass at the declared release checkpoint
public claims, evidence, registry and provenance agree
Owner release decision records all residual limitations

release_workflow_audit.duplicate_attempt_policy: Explicit PyPI duplicate failure is accepted; no second upload is attempted by this setup and no credentials are changed.

provenance_policy: UTF-8 with LF newlines and SHA-256 canonical text digests; this plan does not replace execution evidence.
